messages:
leo-release: Kicking off config-only deploy now: routing policy = prefer-region-fallback, batch_window_ms: 10 -> 8, default_request_timeout_ms: 12000 -> 10000, per-customer soft_rate_cap: 300 -> 280 rps. Canary 5% for 30m. Change window 22:00-23:00 PDT. Any objections?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout started: 5% canary, target pools: us-west-2 primary, eu-west-1 fallback. ID: deploy-2335000001-config. Logs: https://deploys/internal/2335000001
ben-sre: Please add rollback criteria in thread. Propose: error_rate_inc > 0.5% absolute OR p95 latency +150ms OR token_cost > +8% over baseline. If any tripped, auto-cut to 0% and notify oncall.
anya-ml: LGTM. Curious — any change to kv-cache or prefix caching? That can affect cold-start latency.
leo-release: No kv-cache changes. Only routing & batching windows. We reduced continuous-batch max_wait by 2ms to tighten latency tail.
sara-frontender: Heads-up: we'll pin model routing for dedicated customers? Some teams rely on region pinning.
leo-release: Yes — per-customer route pins remain untouched. This only affects global default routing for unpinned requests.
maria-ops: Oncall here. I'll watch infra dashboards. Add me to the alert runbook: runbook.link/cfg-deploy
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary scaled to 5% at 2335000006; health checks passing (all 20/20).
ben-sre: Quick sanity check: can we keep a 10-minute cool-down between any subsequent config-only rollouts? Prevents thrash.
leo-release: :thumbsup: Yes, cooling = 10m enforced in deploy config.
anya-ml: Request: add a smoke evaluation job to run sample prompt set (latency & token quality) at 10m + 25m post-deploy.
leo-release: Added smoke eval to pipeline. Command: ```curl -XPOST https://evals.internal/run -d '{\"suite\":\"routing-smoke\"}'```
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: smoke eval job queued (id: ev-2335000001).
ben-sre: If anything looks off, we'll roll to 0%. Maria, are you good for 22:15 standby?
maria-ops: I'll be at my desk. Slack + pager, I'll escalate to infra lead if thresholds hit.
sara-frontender: Release notes draft for docs: 'Reduced default request timeout from 12s to 10s; tightened batching window to reduce p95. No behavior change for pinned routes.' Anyone edit?
anya-ml: Add note: potential small improvement in tail latency for chat flows.
leo-release: Final check: gate is clear. rolling. ping me for rollback.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary steady at 5% 00:00:30 later. Metrics: error_rate delta +0.02%, p95 latency -18ms, token_cost -1.1%
ben-sre: Looks good. Proceed to ramp to 25% in 15m if metrics remain healthy.
leo-release: Will ramp to 25% at 2335000096 unless team calls.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled ramp to 25% at 2335000096. to_cancel: noop
maria-ops: Noted. Logging notify: operations channel and create incident stub if error_rate >0.5%.
sara-frontender: :thumbsup: I'll update docs with the note and add a small FAQ about timeouts
